debt.text: Sorensen says he is working to protect and expand Social Security benefits and to safeguard the stability of Medicare.
debt.quote: I'm working to protect and expand Social Security benefits for seniors to ensure they can maintain a good quality of life.

schools.text: Sorensen says the country needs to invest in public schools, students, teachers and staff.
schools.quote: We need to invest in our public schools, students, teachers, and volunteers

safety.text: Sorensen says he is working to invest more in local law enforcement for training, recruitment and retention.
safety.quote: invest more into local law enforcement agencies to support their training needs, help them better retain and recruit officers

guns.text: Sorensen supports an assault weapons ban and cosponsored gun-safety legislation, saying military-style weapons do not belong on the streets.
guns.quote: Military-style assault weapons, capable of killing dozens of people in minutes, do not belong on our streets.

abortion.text: Sorensen says abortion decisions should be made between a person and their doctor rather than by lawmakers.
abortion.quote: I believe that reproductive health care decisions should be made between an individual and their doctor – not lawmakers.

health.text: Sorensen says he is working to make health care more affordable and accessible and advocates for Medicare stability and lower drug costs.
health.quote: I believe everyone has the right to be healthy, which is why I'm working in Congress to make health care more affordable, accessible, and efficient.

energy.text: Sorensen says the climate is changing and calls for protecting homes and farms while investing in clean power sources.
energy.quote: and other adverse weather events while investing in clean power sources

tax.text: Vancil says he would push to eliminate federal income taxes on the first $25,000 of income for individuals and $50,000 for married couples.
tax.quote: I will push to eliminate federal income taxes on the first 25,000 dollars of income for individuals and 50,000 dollars for married couples

debt.text: Vancil says Social Security and Medicare need responsible changes to address their long-term finances rather than continuing as they are.
debt.quote: We absolutely need to make responsible changes to Social Security and Medicare

immigration.text: Vancil called for stronger border security, while also saying he wants to make legal immigration easier for skilled workers.
immigration.quote: We need to get serious about border security so no future administration can repeat what we saw under the Biden administration

energy.text: Vancil calls for reversing restrictions on baseload power, resuming coal use, expanding natural gas, and investing in nuclear to lower energy costs.
energy.quote: That means reversing the war on reliable baseload power and letting us start burning coal again, expanding natural gas, and investing in safe nuclear
